name: scammer
title_zh: 一眼定位你正站在骗局第几步的套路识别器
tagline_zh: 收到可疑消息别急着删——它帮你定位骗局阶段，预判骗子下一步。像有个反诈老手在边上，专治「差点就信了」的瞬间。
tagline_en: Don't just delete suspicious texts—let it map the scam phase and predict the next move. Like a fraud expert.
desc_en: 骗子.skill — 把骗局套路蒸馏成 AI，检测可疑消息，定位当前阶段，预判下一步。Distill scam patterns into AI, detect suspicious messages, locate current phase, predict next move.
why_zh: 不是简单关键词黑名单，而是把骗局拆成可识别的阶段模型，让你知道骗子现在在哪、下一步要干嘛。
why_en: Not a keyword blacklist—it models scam phases so you see where the con artist is and what's next, shifting you from reactive to.
limit_zh: 只识别文本消息中的套路，不处理语音、链接跳转后的页面内容；对新型骗局（未收录模式）可能误判为安全，仍需人工警惕。
limit_en: Text-only scam detection; no voice or post-link page analysis. Novel patterns may slip through—stay alert for human judgment.
title_en: Scam-phase locator: know which step you're on
